user: Document operations staff organizing inconsistent filenames
input: Relative-path document manifest with short summaries and purpose-defined destination folders
bottleneck: Manual semantic filing decisions and duplicate destination filenames
ai: Local MiniLM neural embeddings of summaries and folder purposes
